description: Massachusetts RAFT provides short-term help with housing emergencies. The Housing Help Hub accepts applications, and regional agencies handle review and case questions.
introduction: Massachusetts RAFT provides short-term help with housing emergencies. The Housing Help Hub accepts applications, and regional agencies handle review and case questions.

who: Households facing loss of housing, foreclosure, utility shutoff or another documented housing crisis.
Income normally below 50% of local area median income; the state lists a higher threshold for households at risk of domestic violence.
sections.get: Approved assistance may address rent, mortgage, utilities or moving costs. Explain which expense threatens your housing and provide supporting notices.
sections.docs: The head of household’s ID, current housing proof and crisis documentation are required. Income may be checked electronically; additional proof can be requested.
sections.apply:
1. Use the Housing Help Hub linked from the state RAFT application page.
  2. Submit your application and keep the case number.
  3. If landlord participation is needed, ask the landlord to submit their application promptly; the state lists a 21-day limit.
  4. Contact your regional administering agency if you cannot apply online.
sections.after: Read requests for missing information and upload it through the Hub. Ask the assigned agency about case status. A denial email explains how to request review. Do not assume applying changes a court or utility deadline.
sections.sources:
• RAFT application and review process
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Ask the regional agency to assess your household; the program addresses household housing emergencies.
211 answers general questions; contact the agency assigned to your application for case status.
Does my landlord need to apply?
For assistance requiring landlord participation, the landlord must submit an application too.
The Housing Help Hub supports additional document uploads.
Keep following court instructions and seek legal help about your deadlines.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
